messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023 (i.e., the statutory holiday fell on a weekday that was adjacent to a weekend, giving you an extra day off).  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the “observed” day is usually the following Monday.)

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **Jan 2** | Mon | New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 1 was Sunday |
| **Feb 20** | Mon | Family Day (Alberta, BC, NB, ON, PEI, SK) | Observed on Monday |
| **Apr 7** | Fri | Good Friday | |
| **May 22** | Mon | Victoria Day | |
| **Jul 3** | Mon | Canada Day (observed) | Jul 1 was Saturday |
| **Sep 4** | Mon | Labour Day | |
| **Oct 9** | Mon | Thanksgiving | |
| **Nov 10** | Mon | Remembrance Day (observed in Ontario, PEI, SK) | |
| **Dec 26** | Mon | Boxing Day (observed) | Dec 26 was Monday |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • If you want to be province‑specific, add the provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Natal Day in Nova Scotia, etc.).  
> • For holidays that fall on a Thursday or Tuesday, many employers give a “bridge” day off—consider adding a flag for “bridge day” if you want to capture those extra long weekends.  

Happy planning!
